 Final 3 PS Plus Extra Games for October 2026 Available to Download Now 
 New additions for UK, USA, and Japan out now
 by Liam Croft 
 8 hours ago 
 Share:
 For any PS Plus Extra subscribers in the UK, USA, and Japan, today marks the final drop of PS5 titles for October 2026.
 Everyone else in the world received access to the games last week, but Sony's experiment means select members have had to wait until today for the complete lineup.
 As of today, the following PS5 titles are available on PS Plus Extra:
 Poppy Playtime: Chapter 2 (PS5)
 Tales of Arise: Beyond the Dawn Edition (PS5, PS4)
 Monster Energy Supercross 25: The Official Video Game (PS5)
 They're available to download now, and more PS Plus news isn't far behind: the announcement of November 2026's PS Plus Essential games will take place tomorrow, 28th October 2026.
 Related Articles
 Guide All PS Plus Games Available Now 
 Every PS Plus game, updated in one place
 The standout experience here is Tales of Arise , which also includes its post-launch expansion as the Beyond the Dawn Edition . If you've got the spare time to play it in amongst all the new releases, then it's a JRPG well worth playing.
 Subscribe to Push Square on YouTube 172k 
 In regards to the base title, we awarded it a 9/10 score and said: "With its picturesque landscapes instilling a real sense of adventure, it's easily one of the strongest, most cohesive Tales games to date. Dramatic cutscenes and memorable character moments help sell an intriguing story, while a satisfying combat system becomes more and more engaging as your party powers up."
 The DLC, Beyond the Dawn, then was rated 7/10 by us: "It's guilty of treading overly familiar ground, and the storytelling can feel a bit tedious, but there's fun to be found in exploring all-new dungeons and taking on powerful opponents."
 Will you play any of these games on PS Plus Extra? Let us know in the comments below.
